authorship: Codex visual inspection of r0 screenshot; no model generated these critiques
observation: Attractive dark bioluminescent mood, but the play field is nearly empty and the required player with net is absent. Tiny glowing creatures lack recognizable form; CTA is detached at bottom.

independent_axis_critiques.layout: Add a visible player silhouette and organize creatures around a readable capture zone.
independent_axis_critiques.spacing: Use the center and lower field; connect Collection control to HUD/action area.
independent_axis_critiques.color_type: Lift terrain silhouettes slightly and use two creature accent families for depth.
independent_axis_critiques.style_orig: Design recognizable luminous creature species and a crafted net/capture interaction, not generic dots.

cross_critique_tradeoff: Adding readable figures can ruin the mysterious darkness. Use silhouettes, rim light and selective glow rather than brightening the whole field.
fused_revision: Preserve the excellent nocturnal bioluminescent identity but make it read as a game. Add a clearly recognizable player silhouette with a net in the lower field, turn the glowing dots into a few distinct creature forms at different depths, reveal subtle terrain silhouettes, and integrate the Collection control with the HUD. Keep most of the darkness and avoid generic cards or excessive text.
axes_moderated_revision: Build a focal capture zone in the lower-center with a rim-lit player and readable net gesture. Arrange three distinct luminous creatures along a depth arc and strengthen subtle terrain layers so the field reads spatially. Align the collection count and button as one control system. Preserve the black/teal/magenta palette and sparse cinematic mood.
mad_moderated_revision: Keep the darkness as the identity: reveal gameplay through silhouettes and localized glow only. Add one lower-center player with an unmistakable net, three recognizable creature silhouettes at varied depth, and a faint terrain path connecting them. Move the Collection action near the count HUD. Do not fill the field with panels, labels or brighter ambient light.
